description: Belangrijkste incidenten en gevolgen voor de stiptheid is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Lijst van incidenten die in de loop van de maand meer dan 1.000 minuten vertraging bij reizigerstreinen hebben veroorzaakt. In de dataset is ook opgenomen hoeveel minuten vertraging en hoeveel afgeschafte reizigerstreinen aan dit incident worden toegeschreven. Het lijnnummer en de plaats van het incident zijn ook gegeven. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Traffic beheer. Its keywords are Stiptheid, Incidenten, Reizigers, Afgeschafte treinen. The portal shows 2025-11-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
